pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, dark-pigmented polygonal regions exhibiting high edge complexity with jagged, frilled boundaries. Pixel gradients between dark and light regions are distinct and sharp, showing non-geometric, organic leaf-like extensions into the negative space.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Narrow, light-colored pathways forming a continuous topological web. Junction nodes predominantly consist of tri-point and quadri-point intersections. Pixel thickness is relatively uniform but significantly smaller than the area of the dark patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder ridge, corresponding to short, upright mane hairs visible against the background sky.
